## 主张 Claim

固定新内容的实际含义与正面解释时，既有两层比较在所有新内容分类下严格支持 A 胜于 B，恰当且仅当 A 保留 B 的全部新内容、且全列一般增益时 A 仍严格更好。等价地，两端点分类的同向严格比较覆盖所有混合分类。此输出接成每种分类下的组织形成要求，但不保证同一方案在所有分类下未被击败。 / For fixed meanings and positive interpretation of fresh contents, the existing two-tier comparator strictly prefers A to B under every fresh classification exactly when A retains all fresh contents of B and is better with all fresh contents secondary. Equivalently, strict agreement at both extreme assignments covers every mixed assignment. This supplies required formation under each classification, without ensuring a common undefeated implementation.

Canonical source: [ClassificationRobustJudgment.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/ClassificationRobustJudgment.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 同一展开中的旧、新内容、其实际实现与损失有稳定对应；新内容的生成意义已依 G0 说明，仅优先层次未定。 / Old and fresh contents, their realization and losses have stable correspondence within one unfolding. Fresh generative significance has its G0 interpretation; only priority tier varies.
- 比较明确采用既有 J1/J2 的基本保护严格包含，或基本相同而一般增益严格包含；旧分类固定，一次比较中同一新内容的分类一致。 / The comparator explicitly uses existing J1/J2: strict basic inclusion, or strict gain inclusion at equal basic profiles. Old tiers remain fixed and a fresh classification is consistent across the comparison.
- 组织推论另需有限非空且有实践根据的候选范围，以及每个未形成情形的合格稳健改善见证。 / The formation corollary additionally requires a finite nonempty practically warranted menu and an eligible robust improvement witness for every unformed case.
- 所有分类谓词组成保守数学检验范围；不假定每种任意分类都有现实伦理根据。 / All classification predicates form a conservative mathematical test family; arbitrary assignments are not presumed ethically warranted in reality.

旧／新是同一生成内容被辨明的先后；基本／一般为已有实践承诺中的作用差异，不是两类本体或独立所有者。共同能力的应用直接取既有同一事件法则的共同组合扩展；其正面意义与成本覆盖仍明示。 / Old/new tracks recognition of contents in one unfolding; basic/secondary tracks their roles under existing practical commitments, not two ontologies or independent owners. The joint-capacity application directly consumes a joint-bundle extension under the existing single event law; positive significance and cost coverage remain explicit.

## 检验与边界 Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1 实查13项新定理声明／25项审计，73项继承定理／144项审计分列；新增15项空依赖、2项 propext/Quot.sound、8项另含 Classical.choice，无自定义公理。作者反审；无新经验验证或独立 agent 验收。 / Lean 4.29.1 checked 13 new theorem declarations/25 audits; 73 inherited theorems/144 audits are separate. New audits: 15 empty, 2 propext/Quot.sound, 8 also Classical.choice; no custom axioms. Author counterreview, with no new empirical validation or independent-agent acceptance.

只检验已辨明正面内容的优先分类；不是新生活的一般基本地位识别、现实统一最佳方案、G0/J 无前提证明或必然服从。稳健严格比较为充分根据，不是一切合理行动的必要条件；三路反例不证明完整生活关系允许任意分类。 / Tests priority classification of positively understood contents, not universal basic-status recognition, a real common best plan, premise-free G0/J or inevitable compliance. Robust strictness is sufficient, not necessary for every justified action; the three-route example does not show that full living relations allow arbitrary classifications.
